title: India R1/R2 Ranking · confidence + top-3 slot filter
reason: Two mechanisms compound to produce India's negative alpha vs universe: (a) R1 top-3 slot is anti-correlated with outcome when ma20_dist is outside +1..+5, and (b) confidence 70-85 band is an anti-signal. Applying both filters in shadow should raise India 5D WR toward or above universe baseline 32.25%.
